description: What a podcast episode actually said about a topic, with timestamps: fetches the episode's publisher-provided transcript (Podcasting 2.0 <podcast:transcript>, as SRT, WebVTT, JSON, plain text or HTML) and returns the passages that match a query, each with start and end time, the speakers when the file names them, and the matched words. Defaults to the newest episode that has a transcript; name one by guid, URL, episode number or title words. A plain-text transcript without timing is returned as text passages with a note. An episode with no publisher transcript is reported as such with the episodes that do have one.

episode.description: Which episode: guid, page or audio URL, episode number ("273"), or words from its title. Default: the newest episode with a transcript.

format.description: Preferred transcript format when the episode offers several. Default: JSON, then WebVTT, then SRT, then text.

id.description: The show: a show_id from find_podcast_contacts, the RSS feed URL, or its podcast:guid.

query.description: Words to find in the transcript, e.g. "advertising revenue" or "value for value".

window_seconds.description: How much transcript each passage spans, 10-180 seconds (default 30).

name: search_podcast_transcript
title: Search Podcast Transcript
